"""End-to-end CLI differential against the transcribed model, 4 jobs per batch."""
import json, random, subprocess, sys
sys.path[:0] = ['/workspace/tmp/dev', '/workspace/project', '/opt/emicro-deps']
from model import Model
from rfuzz import generate

LIM = {'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
       'connections': 4096, 'packets': 32768, 'files': 8192}


def build(rng, seed):
    jobs = []
    expectations = []
    for index in range(rng.randint(1, 4)):
        if rng.random() < .2:
            jobs.append({'services': [], 'limits': {}, 'events': []})
            expectations.append({'error': 'invalid'})
            continue
        size = rng.randint(1, 4)
        names = [chr(ord('A') + i) for i in range(size)]
        labels = rng.sample(range(1, 60), size)
        services = [{'name': n, 'label': l} for n, l in zip(names, labels)]
        rng.shuffle(services)
        limits = dict(LIM)
        if rng.random() < .5:
            limits.update({'images': rng.randint(1, 3), 'units': rng.randint(1, 3),
                           'contexts': rng.randint(1, 5), 'packets': rng.randint(1, 3),
                           'connections': rng.randint(1, 2), 'files': rng.randint(1, 2),
                           'cells': rng.choice([2, 4, 16, 262144])})
        events = generate(rng, services, limits, rng.randint(1, 250))
        jobs.append({'services': services, 'limits': limits, 'events': events})
        model = Model(services, limits)
        outcomes = [model.do(event) for event in events]
        expectations.append({'events': outcomes})
    return jobs, expectations


def main(rounds=40, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bad = 0
    for round_index in range(rounds):
        jobs, expectations = build(rng, seed + round_index)
        payload = json.dumps({'jobs': jobs}, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
        proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/launch.py', '/workspace/project'],
                              input=payload, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                              cwd='/workspace', env={'PATH': '/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',
                                                     'HOME': '/workspace', 'TMPDIR': '/workspace/tmp',
                                                     'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'},
                              timeout=180)
        if proc.returncode:
            print('exit', proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:400]); bad += 1; continue
        got = json.loads(proc.stdout)
        if got != {'results': expectations}:
            bad += 1
            print('MISMATCH round', round_index)
            for position, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(got.get('results', []), expectations)):
                if a != b:
                    entries = a.get('events', []) if isinstance(a, dict) else []
                    want = b.get('events', []) if isinstance(b, dict) else []
                    for k in range(max(len(entries), len(want))):
                        left = entries[k] if k < len(entries) else None
                        right = want[k] if k < len(want) else None
                        if left != right:
                            print('  job', position, 'event', k, jobs[position]['events'][k] if k < len(jobs[position]['events']) else None)
                            print('   got ', json.dumps(left)[:200])
                            print('   want', json.dumps(right)[:200])
                            break
                    break
        if bad > 3:
            break
    print('e2e rounds=%d failures=%d' % (rounds, bad))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 40, int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 1)
PYEOF
